passives.name: Kalos Spirit
passives.description: Powers up the special attack moves of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits ]%. Reduces special attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits Idx="1" ]%. The more allied sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by [Digit:2digits Idx="3" ]% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is [Digit:2digits Idx="4" ]%, and the maximum damage reduction is [Digit:2digits Idx="5" ]%.)

passives.name: No Quarter
passives.description: Maximizes the number of times the user hits with a move that has the multistrike effect tag when that move is successful.

passives.name: Unfortunate Strike 9
passives.description: Lowers one of the target’s following stats by one stat rank at random when the user’s attack move against it hits: Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed, accuracy, or evasiveness. If the move has the multistrike effect tag, lowers one of the target’s following stats by one stat rank at random for each hit: Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed, accuracy, or evasiveness.
